readinessChecks.message: The checked operations runbook is available.
The 3-run smoke schedule exposes ready, waiting, and missed-run policies.
The full 100-run materialization has no duplicate campaign date/window keys.
The launch path stays on the baseline method until an approved prospective method update exists.
The runner policy marks missed windows instead of backfilling forecasts after forecastCloseAt.
The optional historical-only pre-calibration path is ready when the operator requests it.
The operator must confirm opt-in source availability and outcome evidence location before effectful writes.

manualPrerequisites.requirement: Run the pilot from a supervised terminal session with logs retained outside the generated fixture tree.
manualPrerequisites.confirmation: Operator confirms foreground terminal supervision before using --write-local.
manualPrerequisites.whyManual: Normal checks cannot supervise a long-running local terminal.

manualPrerequisites.requirement: Confirm the local clock is synchronized before each forecast creation window.
manualPrerequisites.confirmation: Operator confirms the clock before running the launch command.
manualPrerequisites.whyManual: Clock drift is environmental and cannot be asserted by committed fixtures.

manualPrerequisites.requirement: Confirm opt-in weather and HSL transit outcome sources are available under the declared source policy.
manualPrerequisites.confirmation: Operator confirms source availability and policy fit before effectful forecast or resolution commands.
manualPrerequisites.whyManual: Normal checks stay offline and do not fetch live source data.

manualPrerequisites.requirement: Prepare the approved outcome CSV/JSON path for each due resolution.
manualPrerequisites.confirmation: Operator confirms outcome files contain only resolution-time evidence.
manualPrerequisites.whyManual: Outcome evidence is local pilot data and must not be committed as a generated fixture.

manualPrerequisites.requirement: Confirm the ignored .ope/live workspace has enough local disk headroom for 100 run states and logs.
manualPrerequisites.confirmation: Operator confirms capacity before starting the 100-run pilot.
manualPrerequisites.whyManual: Disk capacity is machine-local and not stable enough for committed fixture assertions.

launchCommands.expected: Read the launch gate and manual prerequisites.
Inspect all 100 planned runs and duplicate keys.
Inspect the historical-only baseline pre-calibration binding before requesting it at launch.
Create exactly one next-due local campaign forecast before forecastCloseAt, writing pre-calibration first when requested.
Inspect next forecast, next resolution, append readiness, ledger counts, and calibration progress.

blockedActions.reason: Normal checks must remain offline and non-mutating.
blockedActions.safeAlternative: Use pilot-readiness and mini-smoke readbacks during normal checks.

blockedActions.reason: Backfilled forecasts would violate forecast-before-outcome evidence boundaries.
blockedActions.safeAlternative: Record the run as missed and continue with the next eligible service window.

blockedActions.reason: Changing methods before calibration, benchmark, approval, and rollback gates would rewrite the pilot premise.
blockedActions.safeAlternative: Continue with transitmethod-100 until apply-method-update is explicitly approved and written prospectively.

blockedActions.reason: Unresolved or unscored rows cannot be comparable evidence.
blockedActions.safeAlternative: Resolve and score the local run first, or append only an explicit exclusion audit row.

warnings: This readiness readback does not start the pilot; effectful launch still requires --write-local.
Manual source, clock, terminal, outcome-path, and workspace-capacity confirmations remain outside normal checks.
Optional pre-calibration is historical-only and writes local binding state only when requested with --pre-calibrate and --write-local.
The pilot starts on transitmethod-100; method updates remain prospective and approval-gated.
